matchingRules.description: Two account records are the same household or the same organization when they share a name and either a billing postal code or a billing street. The name on its own is not enough: half the households in a county are called the Smith Household, and a rule that matched on the name alone would propose all of them (canonical model R-DP2). Every comparison is exact and none matches on a blank value.
matchingRules.label: Open Impact household match
